metadata.description: The gated Claude x Codex build loop — plan gate, persistent implementer thread, diff review gate, one-writer lock.

plugins.name: codex-loop
plugins.description: Delegate serious multi-file work to Codex CLI under two hard gates: Claude approves the plan Codex authored, Codex implements that same plan from the SAME persistent thread, Claude reviews the diff against it. Pipelined two-lane driver, mkdir writer lock, schema-checked verdicts.
